name: Uderns
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy village in the Zillertal with the Fügen Spa World and an ideal location for excursions throughout the valley.
beschreibung:
Uderns lies on a sunny terrace at the entrance to the Vorderes Zillertal at 549 metres above sea level and has around 1,900 inhabitants. The municipality belongs to the district of Schwaz and is directly connected to public transport by the Zillertalbahn – the railway station makes the village especially attractive for holidaymakers who are travelling without a car.

The location between Fügen and Ried proves to be a practical starting point for activities throughout the valley: the Spieljochbahn in Fügen can be reached by bike or bus in just a few minutes, the Erlebnistherme Fügener Badewelt is practically on the doorstep, and cyclists appreciate the entry point to the Zillertalradweg. In summer, marked hiking trails lead over the Uderner Alm up towards Spieljoch; in winter, the Hochzillertal and Spieljoch ski areas are quickly reachable. The surroundings are shaped by traditional agriculture – many farms still run their own alpine dairies, and preserving farming structures is important to the people of Uderns.

Culturally, the parish church with its distinctive tower shapes the village scene, and local club life – from the marksmen's company to the brass band – is closely interwoven with the customs of the Zillertal. Anyone who wants to try Tiroler cuisine away from the tourist trails will find authentic regional dishes such as Zillertaler Krapfen or Kaspressknödel in the village inns. Uderns is not a place for grand staging, but for all who want to experience the Zillertal actively and yet quietly. 🏘️
